resources.string: Sensitive Advanced: inspect likely plaintext
Off by default. This is a separate session-only feature, not normal network monitoring.
Enable sensitive payload inspection
Sensitive inspection controls are shown.
Payload inspection remains off; metadata monitoring still works.

Only likely plaintext is considered. TLS is never decrypted and reassembly is not performed. Cleartext can contain credentials; redaction is best-effort. Data stays only in memory, is zeroized when monitoring stops, and cannot be saved, copied, shared, or exported. This protected Network screen blocks screenshots and recent-app previews.
